تأيرنت (form IIq)
# تَأَيْرَنْتُ (taʔayrantu) /ta.ʔaj.ran.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# تَأَيْرَنْتَ (taʔayranta) /ta.ʔaj.ran.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# تَأَيْرَنْتِ (taʔayranti) /ta.ʔaj.ran.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# تَأَيْرَنَتْ (taʔayranat) /ta.ʔaj.ra.nat/: t
